backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing user registration with access control plus Stripe session creation and status checks.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to files, components, and tests for verification.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of many frontend React components and utilities.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global stylesheet defining OKLCH color variables and light/dark theme tokens.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML document loading the PWA manifest, icons, and React entry point.
frontend/PLAY_STORE_BUILD.md: Guide explaining how to package the app as a TWA for Play Store submission including required assets and URLs.
frontend/public/.well-known/ASSETLINKS_S: Documentation explaining how to configure Digital Asset Links for TWA verification.
frontend/public/.well-known/assetlinks.j: Template Digital Asset Links file with placeholder package name and SHA‑256 fingerprint.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: Web manifest defining app metadata, colors, icons, and PWA shortcuts.
frontend/public/offline.html: Custom offline fallback page shown when the PWA is offline.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker handling precaching, cache cleanup, and network-first fetch logic with offline fallback.
frontend/scripts/twa/.gitignore: Ignores TWA build artifacts like APK/AAB files while keeping helper scripts.
Automates Bubblewrap-based TWA build, including prerequisites check, keystore setup, project init, and release build.
frontend/scripts/twa/README.md: Documentation for building a TWA package, listing prerequisites and workflow steps.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that routes pages based on URL hash and conditionally renders header and footer.
frontend/src/components/DataPlansSection: Displays mobile data plans with network filtering, purchase options, and bank transfer dialog support.
frontend/src/components/IBNFooter.tsx: Footer component with branding, quick links, contact info, and smooth-scroll navigation.
frontend/src/components/IBNHeader.tsx: Header showing navigation, account actions, and admin setup dialogs based on authentication state.
frontend/src/components/LandingPage.tsx: Main landing page composing hero, stats, CTA buttons, and section components for how it works, plans, about, testimonials, FAQ, and Play Store guide.
frontend/src/components/LandingPageSecti: Renders a FAQ section using an accordion with predefined questions and answers about data plans and service usage.
Displays a three‑step process explaining how to choose a plan, pay, and receive data, using cards with icons and descriptions.
Provides guidance and required resources for publishing the web app to Google Play Store, including links, checklists, and build instructions.
Shows customer testimonials with names, roles, ratings, and quotes using card layouts.
frontend/src/components/payments/BankTra: Admin form for creating and managing bank transfer accounts with validation, dynamic fields, and save actions via queries.
Dialog component showing bank transfer details, allowing users to copy fields and confirm payment via WhatsApp.
frontend/src/components/payments/Payment: Displays a payment cancellation screen with retry and WhatsApp support options.
Verifies Stripe session status and shows success or failure UI based on the payment outcome.
frontend/src/components/payments/PayNowB: Button that triggers Stripe checkout, handling identity login, errors, and redirecting to payment.
frontend/src/components/payments/StripeA: Admin form for configuring Stripe secret keys and allowed countries, with validation and status display.
frontend/src/components/WhatsAppCTA.tsx: Reusable WhatsApp CTA button that opens a chat with a preset message and optional number display.
frontend/src/data/mobileNetworkPlans.ts: Defines mobile network data plans with pricing, features, and metadata for MTN, GLO, Airtel, and 9Mobile.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, recreating it on identity changes and invalidating dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context for Internet Identity authentication, handling login, stored identity loading, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for interacting with backend methods such as Stripe config, checkout sessions, bank accounts, admin checks, and user profiles.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining light/dark theme variables and global styles.
frontend/src/lib/whatsapp.ts: Utility functions for generating WhatsApp URLs, including formatted numbers and pre-filled order or payment messages.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Displays user dashboard, handling authentication redirects, profile loading, and logout actions.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login page enabling Internet Identity sign‑in with loading and error handling.
frontend/src/pages/PrivacyPolicyPage.tsx: React page rendering a detailed privacy policy with sections on data collection, usage, security, and third‑party services.
frontend/src/pages/RegisterPage.tsx: Registration page handling Internet Identity login and user registration form submission with validation and navigation.
frontend/src/utils/hashRoute.ts: Provides simple hash-based routing helpers for reading and navigating routes.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters, including support for hash-based routing and session storage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining theme extensions, colors, typography, container settings, and plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks project state, features, requirements, and Play Store asset needs for deployment planning.
